comment: The pitch knobs, switches, ratios and gate pattern are all held per layer in the module rather than in the parameters (Strata.cpp:1425), so changing layer writes the stored values back into the controls and at any other moment the controls are read back into storage. A row whose step count reaches none is switched off and stops contributing (Strata.cpp:1524). The eight pitch stages are switched in and out in two groups of four and the last one left in a group cannot be switched out (Strata.cpp:1430). The octave destination switch decides whether the octave transposition applies to stages one to four, five to eight, or all of them (Strata.cpp:1518).
